updates.title: Broccoli Client V1
updates.body:
Hello everyone!
This is gonna be the first version of broccoli client. it has a normal desktop build, and a browser build.

Broccoli Client is a fork off of incari with some added modules and bug fixes.
50% of its codebase is Incari.
The other 50% is bug fixes, patches, and manually inputed features.
Please enjoy Broccoli client.

Im gonna be fixing the autoupdate feature, join the discord!
